content.title: What Time Is The ‘Hannah Montana’ 20th Anniversary Special On Disney+? How To Watch
content.text: Miley CyrusCourtesy of The Walt Disney CompanyMiley Cyrus is enjoying the best of both worlds again. Nearly 20 years after Hannah Montana first aired on Disney Channel, she’s stepping back into the role that catapulted her to fame with a new anniversary special on Disney+ and Hulu.The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special was filmed with a live studio audience and includes an in-depth interview with Cyrus, hosted by Call Her Daddy podcast host Alex Cooper. The special also features never-before-seen archival footage and recreated sets from the original show, like the Stewart beach house and Hannah’s iconic 2000s closet.During the taping, Cyrus took the stage as Hannah, wearing her blonde bangs styled like the character instead of a wig. She performed show favorites like “This Is the Life,” “The Climb,” and “The Best of Both Worlds,” according to Variety. She also reportedly sang a brand new song for fans.ForbesWhy Emily Osment And Mitchel Musso Are Missing From ‘Hannah Montana’ 20th AnniversaryBy Monica Mercuri“Hannah Montana will always be a part of who I am. What started as a TV show became a shared experience that shaped my life and the lives of so many fans, and I’ll always be thankful for that connection,” Cyrus said in a press release. “The fact that it still means so much to people all these years later is something I’m very proud of. This ‘Hannahversary’ is my way of celebrating and thanking the fans who’ve stood by me for 20 years.”MORE FOR YOUHere’s everything fans need to know about watching the highly anticipated special, including its start time, how to stream it and who will be there.What Time Is The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special Coming Out On Disney+?Miley Cyrus and Emily Osment in Hannah Montana.Courtesy of The Walt Disney CompanyThe 20th anniversary special of Hannah Montana premieres on Tuesday, March 24, at 3 a.m. ET/midnight PT on Disney+ and Hulu.How Long Is The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special?The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special will run for one hour. Part of the special includes Cyrus’ sit-down interview with Cooper, which will “offer an intimate look at the creation of one of pop culture’s most iconic characters and the lasting impact the show and character have had on fans around the world,” according to Disney. Email Address Who Will Be At The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special?Miley Cyrus and Billy Ray Cyrus in Hannah MontanaCourtesy of The Walt Disney CompanyCyrus will be joined by several family members and stars from the hit Disney Channel series. The singer confirmed that fellow Disney Channel alum Selena Gomez, who guest-starred on Hannah Montana as Miley’s rival, Mikayla, will appear in the special.The star’s real-life father and on-screen dad, Billy Ray Cyrus, who played Robby Ray Stewart on the show, is also set to appear, according to the trailer. Her mother, Tish Cyrus, will be featured as well, with the mother-daughter duo revisiting Hannah’s iconic dream bedroom closet.While co-stars Emily Osment and Jason Earles have both acknowledged the 20th anniversary on social media, it’s unclear whether they will appear in the special in some capacity, according to Variety.How To Watch The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary SpecialMiley Cyrus as Hannah MontanaMiley Cyrus and Billy Ray Cyrus in Hannah MontanaThe Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special is available exclusively on Hulu and Disney+. The Hulu and Disney+ bundle starts at $12.99 per month, while the Disney+ and Hulu Bundle Premium costs $19.99 per month. Hulu is also available as a standalone service, with plans starting at $11.99 per month.Fans without a subscription may want to take advantage of a limited-time promotion currently available. From March 5 through March 24, new subscribers can sign up for the Disney+ and Hulu Bundle at $4.99 per month for the first 3 months. More details about the offer and Hulu’s full pricing options are available on Hulu’s website.Can Fans Watch The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special For Free?Yes! Hulu is currently offering a free trial to new and eligible returning subscribers, so some viewers may be able to watch the special for free. Visit Hulu to learn if you qualify for the free trial.Check out the trailer for the Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special below.
